sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 58.85% (USD 11.58M cumulative volume) and Lula at 40.50% (USD 11.96M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 23/Sep, 11:54 BRT. The gap is 18.35pp, against 19.05pp in the reading confirmed on 22/Sep at 14:40 BRT, and it is the second day running that it narrows.
sentimento.text2: ⚖️ And Lula's price did NOT move: he is at 40.50% in both readings, and the one who gave ground was Flávio Bolsonaro, 0.70pp. Normalized by the sum of the pair, which deflated from 100.05 to 99.35, the reading becomes another one: Lula gains 0.29pp of implied probability with a flat price, and Flávio Bolsonaro gives up the same 0.29pp. It is the cleanest case of the binary pair this panel has recorded, because one of the sides stayed exactly the same. ⚠️ Neither is an extreme: Flávio Bolsonaro's price stands 2.85pp below the series high, 61.70% on 21/Sep, and Lula's 6.00pp above his low, 34.50% on 25/Apr.
sentimento.text3: ⭐ On the poll side, AtlasIntel in partnership with Bloomberg came in, registration BR-04739/2026, 5,015 participants online between 17 and 22/Sep with a 1.0pp margin. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) Lula has 45.8% and Flávio Bolsonaro 43.4%, and the distance between them did not move against the house's 17/Sep round: both rose 1.7pp and what gave ground was the whole third way, with Augusto Cury from 3.5% to 2.1%, Renan Santos from 5.1% to 4.5% and blank and null from 1.6% to 0.7%. 🔑 In the main [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing the sign flipped inside the house itself: Lula has 47.7% against 47.4%, after 46.8% to 47.2% on 17/Sep, and the house declares a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) for the third week running.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 58.85% in the winner contract (USD 11.58M cumulative volume), down 0.70pp raw and 0.29pp normalized in the reading confirmed on 23/Sep, 11:54 BRT. His price stands 2.85pp below the series high, 61.70% on 21/Sep. ⭐ In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he went the other way and RISES 2.00pp raw and 3.46pp normalized, to 71.50% (USD 1.08M), because that pair deflated from 99.30 to 97.35. At AtlasIntel of 23/Sep he has 43.4% in the first round and loses the numerical lead he had in that house's [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 40.50% in the winner contract (USD 11.96M cumulative volume), with NO new price in the reading confirmed on 23/Sep, 11:54 BRT, and up 0.29pp normalized. ⚠️ It is not an extreme: his price stands 27.00pp below the series high, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 6.00pp above the low, 34.50% on 25/Apr. 🔴 In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he has the largest fall of the round, 3.95pp raw and 3.46pp normalized, to 25.85% (USD 0.90M). At AtlasIntel of 23/Sep he leads the first round with 45.8% and comes out ahead in the main [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing.
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 IN THE [FIRST-ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT THE CONVERGENCE STOPPED AND WENT BACKWARDS: the distance between Renan Santos and Augusto Cury WIDENED from 3.05pp to 4.15pp. Renan Santos rises 1.50pp, to 44.00% (USD 0.40M cumulative volume), the largest rise of the round, and Augusto Cury rises 0.40pp, to 39.85% (USD 0.27M). Ronaldo Caiado gives up 1.00pp, to 14.50% (USD 0.16M), and keeps third place, and Romeu Zema gets no new price, at 0.30%. Across four certified readings the distance between the top two went 19.95pp, 5.25pp, 3.05pp and now 4.15pp. 🏆 And Renan Santos's contract in the WINNER book became the one with the largest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 14.17M against USD 14.09M for Tarcísio de Freitas's.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading confirmed on 23/Sep, 11:54 BRT (14:54 UTC), with the presidential book adding up to USD 154.05M cumulative across 19 contracts. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move goes the one normalized by the sum of the pair, because in a binary contract the sum of the two sides moves on its own and a FLAT price can hide implied probability that did move, which is exactly what happened today.

inss.text1: 🔴 THERE IS NO NEW ACT CONFIRMED BY TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) FRAUD INQUIRY ON 23/Sep. What stands is still the act of 12/Sep, when Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and the procedural suspension he ordered also reaches the INSS cases.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 What links the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) to the Master case here is procedural, not factual, and on 23/Sep the effect of that showed up in a side case: the defense of Felipe Cançado Vorcaro, the bank owner's cousin, argues that sending two petitions to the Court's Presidency, one from the Master case operation and one from the INSS fraud operation, suspended the processing of his request to revoke his pretrial arrest. Fachin's office clarified that the rapporteurship did NOT change and that the records were merely forwarded (Gazeta do Povo).
inss.impactoLula: This panel's approval ruler is still [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 21/Sep, registration BR-06004/2026, with 44% approval against 50% disapproval. ⚠️ AtlasIntel of 23/Sep measures 45.4% approval against 53% disapproval, and compared with that house's own 17/Sep round its approval did NOT move: it was the same 45.4%, with disapproval going from 53.6% to 53%. The other two readings in the window are from 17/Sep, Datafolha at 48% against 50% and Futura/100% Cidades at 44.1% against 53.1%. The spread between houses, 4 points on approval, remains larger than the move of any one of them.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep and 44% against 50% on 21/Sep. The 5-point fall stopped and gave back 1, inside the margin. ⭐ And the RATING ruler moved the opposite way in the SAME Quaest round: negative rose from 38% to 42%, positive from 32% to 33% and fair fell from 27% to 23%. They are two different questions and they do not add up.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the topic is calendar and polling, not an act: there is no new act confirmed by two independent sources in the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) fraud inquiry on 23/Sep, and the news is the AtlasIntel approval reading, in which the house's series did not move on approval and gave up 0.6 point on disapproval.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 ON 22/Sep CRISTIANO ZANIN DENIED THE INJUNCTION that would force the Senate to set up the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) inquiry committee, and the decision became public on 23/Sep. He held that, at this stage, there is no proof of unlawful omission by the Senate president, Davi Alcolumbre, and ordered him to provide information before a new analysis. The request is from senator Alessandro Vieira, filed on 9 March with 41 signatures against the 27 required, and targets ties between Alexandre de Moraes, Dias Toffoli and Daniel Vorcaro (CartaCapital, CNN Brasil, Metrópoles and Gazeta do Povo).
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE SECOND ACT OF THE DAY IS ALSO FROM 22/Sep AND ALSO CAME OUT ON 23/Sep: the president of the Superior Electoral Court, Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered Lula to remove from his social networks, within 24 hours, a video recorded at the Alvorada Palace in which he speaks about the Master case, and barred the use of the material in radio and television campaign broadcasts. The decision answers a request by Flávio Bolsonaro, who argued the post was of mixed nature. In the same order the court gave five days for the Presidency, the communications secretariat and the institutional security office to provide information (Estadão and Grupo Globo).
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ This page's price for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 comes from the reading confirmed on 23/Sep, 11:54 BRT, and stands at 4.30%, with USD 0.09M cumulative volume, with no new price for the second day. AFOS does not attribute this contract's move to coverage of the case: it measures the price and the coverage side by side, each with its own time stamp. 🏷️ And the names are distinguished: the arrest revocation request that has been with Fachin since 18/Sep is Daniel Vorcaro's, and the case reopened on 22/Sep by the defense is that of his cousin, Felipe Cançado Vorcaro.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case moved by judicial decision on 22/Sep and by publication on 23/Sep, and both decisions denied or limited requests: Zanin did not force the Senate to set up the inquiry committee, and the Superior Electoral Court ordered Lula to take a video down at Flávio Bolsonaro's request. The request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's arrest has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, with no decision.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act confirmed by two independent sources on 23/Sep. He is the justice with the highest rejection in the AtlasIntel survey run with Estadão released that day, a study separate from the electoral one, with 1,852 adults interviewed between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos and of Alessandro Vieira's inquiry committee request.
stf.moraes: The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro remains undated, suspended by Flávio Dino's request for review. On 22/Sep he was one of the two justices named in the inquiry committee request that Cristiano Zanin declined to unlock by injunction. Also on 22/Sep he declared himself disqualified from serving as rapporteur of the writ of mandamus on Senate records, which was reassigned to Luiz Fux.
stf.gilmar: On Sep 18 he publicly acknowledged having had a meeting with Daniel Vorcaro and said he voted against Banco Master in a case he described as worth up to R$ 145 billion, saying the vote went against the banker (CartaCapital, Valor Econômico and Gazeta do Povo). On Sep 14 his office had received from the Federal Police the full data extracted from Vorcaro's phone.
stf.dino: On 15/Sep he asked for a review in the ruling on investigating Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the analysis for up to 90 days, and he had not returned the case through 23/Sep. On 17/Sep he asked the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) and the securities regulator to look into ties between [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) and a credit dealership.
stf.mendonca: His 76-page brief, filed on 21/Sep, asks Fachin for summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and for consideration of opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority and false accusation. On 22/Sep the defense of Felipe Cançado Vorcaro again pressed him to analyze that defendant's request to revoke his pretrial arrest, filed three months ago, and Fachin's office clarified that the rapporteurship had not changed.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome, and on 23/Sep it came out measured. In the AtlasIntel survey with Bloomberg, the same electoral round of 5,015 participants between 17 and 22/Sep, 52.3% say the Supreme Court crisis hurts Lula's candidacy more and 20.8% say it hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's more, with 15.5% seeing equal damage to both. On which political group is more involved in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) scheme, 43.8% point to Jair Bolsonaro's allies and 43.4% to Lula's, a tie inside the 1.0pp margin. The house records that fieldwork was done entirely after the Supreme Court session of 15/Sep.
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 4.30% (USD 0.09M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 23/Sep, 11:54 BRT, with no new price for the second day running. It is a thin book, and the absence of a move there is not the absence of news: the price stands 21.80pp below the series high, 26.10% on 11/Sep, and 2.20pp above the low, 2.10% on 08/Jun. ⚠️ Perception of the Court, measured in the AtlasIntel survey with Estadão of 23/Sep, a separate study with 1,852 adults between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin, stands at 61% who say they do not trust the Court's work and its justices against 27.8% who do. That house's series went from 51.3% distrust in August 2025 to 60% in March and 61% now.
stf.fachin: Since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pretrial arrest, with no decision through 23/Sep. He ordered two petitions that were with André Mendonça forwarded to the Presidency, one from the Master case and one from the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) frauds, and his office clarified on 22/Sep that the measure did not change the rapporteurship.
